verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five drawbacks of overstaying.

verses.pali: Āvāsamaccharī hoti, kulamaccharī hoti, lābhamaccharī hoti, vaṇṇamaccharī hoti, dhammamaccharī hoti.
verses.english: You become stingy with dwellings, families, material things, praise, and the teaching.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā atinivāse.
verses.english: These are the five drawbacks of overstaying.
There are these five benefits of staying for a reasonable length of time.

verses.pali: Na āvāsamaccharī hoti, na kulamaccharī hoti, na lābhamaccharī hoti, na vaṇṇamaccharī hoti, na dhammamaccharī hoti.
verses.english: You’re not stingy with dwellings, families, material things, praise, and the teaching.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṁsā samavatthavāse”ti.
verses.english: These are the five benefits of staying for a reasonable length of time.”
